# Posting to Slack: resolve the channel, respect exact message wording

Procedure for tasks that require posting a message to Slack.

1. Resolve the channel first: list/search channels and use the exact channel
   name or ID from the task (e.g. `#ops-alerts`), not a guess.
2. If the target is a person (DM), look up their Slack user ID by name/email
   before sending.
3. When the task dictates message content or a template, reproduce it exactly,
   substituting only the dynamic values gathered from earlier steps.
4. For thread replies, pass the parent message's timestamp/thread ID instead of
   posting a new top-level message.
5. Verify the post succeeded from the tool result before reporting done.

conversation_parts.body: It would be great if the dashboard export supported PDF and SVG formats.

Hi — thanks for your feature request about dashboard export formats. We've classified this under 'Analytics' and created Jira story jira_898547c99b02466f9b2e7f11d96118b8 (TST-24). Affected entity: Dashboard export (formats: PDF, SVG). Relevant amounts: N/A. Batch reference: FEAT-REQ-20260210. We'll update you here with progress. —Product Team
We need higher API rate limits for our integration workflows.

Hi — thanks for requesting higher API rate limits. We've classified this under 'API' and created Jira story jira_5332bdd974cd444a8d28ab018051d050 (TST-24). Affected entity: API rate limit. Relevant amounts: customer requested higher limits; as a preliminary target we've proposed a 5x increase (e.g. from ~60 req/min to ~300 req/min). Batch reference: FEAT-REQ-20260210. We'll update you with any changes. —Product Team
Please add webhook retry logic with exponential backoff.

Hi — thanks for requesting webhook retry improvements. We've classified this under 'API' and created Jira story jira_4578fe02a91446e79077a8eaf44d1f86 (TST-24). Affected entity: Webhook delivery. Relevant amounts: proposed retry policy — up to 5 attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s). Batch reference: FEAT-REQ-20260210. We'll follow up with implementation details. —Product Team
The dashboard needs better date range filter options for custom periods.

Hi — thanks for your request about dashboard date range filters. We've classified this under 'Analytics' and created Jira story jira_790527fb4f6d45318d18e0c194fe952a (TST-24). Affected entity: Dashboard filters (custom periods). Relevant amounts: N/A. Batch reference: FEAT-REQ-20260210. We'll update you when we have a timeline. —Product Team
Need better SSO support for SAML 2.0.

Hi — thanks for the SSO request. We've classified this under 'Security' and created Jira story jira_809b8bd7d2da467696007094d399ce02 (TST-24). Affected entity: SSO (SAML 2.0 support). Relevant amounts: N/A. Batch reference: FEAT-REQ-20260210. We'll keep you posted on progress. —Product Team
We want granular API webhook subscription management for specific events.

Hi — thanks for requesting granular webhook subscription management. We've classified this under 'API' and created Jira story jira_219a75a44d9c414f88e376110b2abd1f (TST-24). Affected entity: Webhook subscription management (event-level subscriptions). Relevant amounts: N/A (supports selecting individual events such as conversation.created, conversation.updated, etc.). Batch reference: FEAT-REQ-20260210. We'll update you with next steps. —Product Team
Add mobile push notification support for ticket updates.

Hi — thanks for requesting mobile push notifications for ticket updates. We've classified this under 'Mobile' and created Jira story jira_9343580274254f4fb3c1aa11c07813df (TST-24). Affected entity: Mobile push notification system. Relevant amounts: N/A. Batch reference: FEAT-REQ-20260210. We'll update you on feasibility and timeline. —Product Team
Your reporting module needs work compared to competitors.

Hi — thanks for the feedback on reporting. We've classified this under 'Analytics' and created Jira story jira_15c0e0e559094b70ba81d6d9a1c92946 (TST-24). Affected entity: Reporting module. Relevant amounts: N/A. Batch reference: FEAT-REQ-20260210. We'll share planned improvements soon. —Product Team
The Slack integration should support thread replies and richer formatting.

Hi — thanks for requesting Slack integration improvements. We've classified this under 'Integrations' and created Jira story jira_3a37afb711dd4a52812dbdbe63d83373 (TST-24). Affected entity: Slack integration (thread replies & richer formatting). Relevant amounts: N/A. Batch reference: FEAT-REQ-20260210. We'll update you as we make progress. —Product Team
